goal_text: Select an observed method in the stated operation domain under the current criterion, or unknown when authorized observations are insufficient.

seeds.observation: FILTRATION_TRIAL: In liquid sample filtration, method VF2 finishes in 4 minutes and removes dissolved tracer. Method ZP8 finishes in 11 minutes and retains dissolved tracer. These observations concern filtration only.
seeds.old_criterion: For liquid sample filtration choose the fastest observed method; dissolved tracer retention is not required.
seeds.decisive_span: Method ZP8 finishes in 11 minutes and retains dissolved tracer.

seeds.observation: WRAPPING_TRIAL: In ceramic parcel wrapping, method GQ5 uses 2 sheets and cracks thin handles. Method BC9 uses 5 sheets and leaves thin handles intact. These observations concern wrapping only.
seeds.old_criterion: For ceramic parcel wrapping choose the observed method using the fewest sheets; thin handle damage is acceptable.
seeds.decisive_span: Method BC9 uses 5 sheets and leaves thin handles intact.

seeds.observation: ARCHIVING_TRIAL: In sensor stream archiving, method JD6 uses 18 MB and drops event timestamps. Method RW3 uses 41 MB and preserves event timestamps. These observations concern archiving only.
seeds.old_criterion: For sensor stream archiving choose the smallest observed archive; event timestamps are unnecessary.
seeds.decisive_span: Method RW3 uses 41 MB and preserves event timestamps.

cases.current_criterion: For liquid sample filtration choose an observed method that retains dissolved tracer; speed does not matter.
For ceramic parcel wrapping choose an observed method that leaves thin handles intact; sheet consumption does not matter.
For metal panel coating choose an observed method that prevents salt corrosion. Observations from other operation domains cannot establish coating performance.
For sensor stream archiving choose an observed method that preserves event timestamps; archive size does not matter. Only currently authorized observations may support the choice.
